items.cheapest_check: NAS admin page -> System -> Firmware update; the NAS's connection log filtered to addresses outside the warehouse.
items.unknown: NAS firmware version, and whether its admin page has seen logins from outside.
items.why: Decides whether Chain A has already happened or is still ahead.

items.cheapest_check: Router admin -> Administration -> Remote management; then the router's public address from a phone off the warehouse network.
items.unknown: Whether the warehouse router's own admin page answers from the internet.
items.why: A second exposed admin page would put the router itself in Chain A.

items.cheapest_check: Entra admin center -> Enterprise applications -> each app's Permissions tab; Consent and permissions -> User consent settings.
items.unknown: App permissions and the user consent setting.
items.why: Decides how far a single staff click can extend app access to mail and files.

items.cheapest_check: A written request to the former provider; meanwhile Enterprise applications sorted by created date, looking before June 2025.
items.unknown: What the former managed IT provider connected to the tenant.
items.why: The only route to an answer on R-2.3, R-4.2 and R-4.4.

items.cheapest_check: Entra admin center -> Authentication methods -> User registration details.
items.why: Security defaults protect only accounts that have registered.

items.cheapest_check: Ask the three triage volunteers and the volunteer coordinator; compare against the roster of volunteers who have left.
items.why: Sets how many people, past and present, can open Chain C.

items.cheapest_check: CMS admin -> Users -> filter Administrator; each account's security settings.
items.unknown: Two-step sign-in on the CMS administrator accounts.
items.why: Decides whether Chain B's account route is open.

items.cheapest_check: Cloud-backup service web console -> version history on one NAS file changed last week.
items.unknown: Version history kept by the cloud-backup service.
items.why: Decides whether Chain A's impact can be rolled back.

items.cheapest_check: Purview portal -> Audit -> search the last 30 days for donations@.
items.unknown: Whether Purview audit is actually recording.
items.why: The 180-day figure is from documentation, not the tenant.

items.cheapest_check: Donor-management service admin settings -> Security, and its notification settings for exports.
items.unknown: Sign-in protection and export alerts on the donor-management service.
items.why: 4,200 donor records sit behind a login no one has checked.
